title: Berry Drop Ice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Guava 30ml
description:
Description
Zesty guava and Blue raspberry served up ice cold.
Berry Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Berry Drop is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
